title: Verify: App header round states unit tests
summary: App renders header for ready, loading and failed round
acceptance_criteria: Ready state asserts round id and status are shown
Pending state asserts 'Loading round…' is shown
Rejected state asserts an alert with 'Round status unavailable: HTTP 500' and no 'Round unavailable' text
technical_constraints: vi.mock('../src/api/client') following the pattern in tests/appFlow.test.tsx; payload from roundFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts (mirrors backend world.Round JSON); no hard-coded payloads

steps.action: Mock getCurrentRound. Render App, click the Begin control used in tests/appFlow.test.tsx to pass the intro. Case resolved(roundFixture): await findByText('round-1') and getByText('OPEN'). Case never-resolving promise: getByText('Loading round…'). Case rejected(new Error('HTTP 500')): await findByRole('alert') toHaveTextContent('Round status unavailable: HTTP 500'); queryByText('Round unavailable') null.
